## Security

Seven security vulnerabilities have been identified and fixed in this release. Users are advised to update `gh` to version `v2.106.0` as soon as possible.

1. The terminal escape-sequence check used by `gh repo read-file`, `gh api`, and other commands did not recognize C1 control characters, allowing untrusted output to reach a terminal without neutralization.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-45h6-2fh4-pr93 for more information.

2. Verbose and API-debug HTTP logging could print untrusted terminal control characters from request and response data.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-4946-22jg-pg7m for more information.

3. `gh codespace ports` could print untrusted terminal control characters from port labels.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-5v78-vjjq-j2fj for more information.

4. `gh agent-task view --log` could print untrusted terminal control characters from tool-call names and arguments.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-3j6c-526c-w465 for more information.

5. `gh skill update` could install a skill from a different repository that reused the installed skill's name.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-q2rq-2r2v-2jm5 for more information.

6. `gh skill install` and `gh skill search` could print untrusted terminal control characters from remote skill text.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-mjfw-qpmw-c8p9 for more information.

7. `gh codespace jupyter` could expose localhost cookies and local development services when connecting to a malicious Codespace.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-mrhx-xw2w-4289 for more information.

## Improved authentication security on logout

`gh auth logout` now revokes the selected account's GitHub CLI OAuth token before removing local credentials. Use `--no-revoke` to preserve the legacy local-only logout, leaving the token valid.

`gh` now also removes saved HTTPS credentials for the host from Git credential helpers.

## Make expiring tokens more reliable

On GitHub Enterprise Server before 3.23, requests for expiring credentials now fall back to a non-expiring token with a warning instead of failing with `invalid_scope`. This applies to `gh auth login`, `gh auth refresh`, and the `expiring_credentials` setting.

## What's Changed

### ✨ Features

* Revoke GitHub CLI OAuth tokens during `gh auth logout` by @BagToad in [#15100](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15100)

### 🐛 Fixes

* fix(run view): preserve log output after lines longer than 64 KiB by @babakks in [#15065](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15065)
* fix(auth): fall back to non-expiring tokens on GitHub Enterprise Server before 3.23 by @BagToad in [#15109](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15109)
* fix(auth): clear saved HTTPS Git helper credentials during logout by @BagToad and @babakks in [#15152](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15152)
* fix(auth): keep a valid credential refreshed by another process after refresh rejection by @babakks in [#15159](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15159)

### 📚 Docs & Chores

* Document that GitHub Event Streams may deliver events more than once by @babakks in [#15094](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15094)
* Patch vulnerable `cli-exercise` runtime dependencies by @babakks in [#15068](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15068)
* Add a bug readiness assessment skill by @tidy-dev in [#15149](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15149)

* chore(deps): bump the `codeql-actions` group from 4.39.3 to 4.39.4 by @dependabot in [#15142](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15142)
* chore(deps): bump `actions/create-github-app-token` from 3.3.0 to 3.4.0 by @dependabot in [#15143](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15143)
* chore(deps): bump `charm.land/bubbles/v2` from 2.2.1 to 2.2.2 by @dependabot in [#15144](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15144)
* chore(deps): bump `charm.land/bubbletea/v2` from 2.1.1 to 2.1.2 by @dependabot in [#15141](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15141)
* chore(deps): bump `github.com/charmbracelet/x/ansi` from 0.11.9 to 0.11.10 by @dependabot in [#15145](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15145)
* chore(deps): bump `github.com/gorilla/websocket` from 1.5.3 to 1.5.4-0.20240701034025-d67f41855da4 by @BagToad in [#15157](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15157)
